summary: internal/cli/skills_test.go now holds TestPluginSkills (frontmatter, command-tree, schema, path, fence and eval-format checks over SKILLCHECK_PLUGIN_DIR or ../../plugin) and TestSkillChecksRejectFixtures, backed by 15 committed fixture plugins; the domain model's On disk block gains the .vloop/tmp/ entries and plan.md.
verified: Ran T1's verify command from state.json; it printed GATE OK.
notes: The checker is named checkSkillPlugin because checkPlugin already exists in version.go. A command word is unknown when its parent has subcommands and the parent's Args validator rejects it (task and config are Runnable with NoArgs, so a Runnable test would have missed `vloop task frobnicate`). The path check reads the On disk block at ../../docs/domain/domain-model.md and normalises every <...> placeholder to one path segment; a path inside an entry ending in / also matches. A fixture folder needs an entry in fixtureWants, and every fixtureWants entry needs a folder. Fixtures are minimal: only the files that carry the defect.
